newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ta Fu says new share offer 148 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Ta Fu says new share offer 148 times subscribed.

text.p: Taiwan-based timber products processor Ta Fu International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday its initial public offering was 148 times subscribed.
Ta Fu offered 168 million new shares at a subscription price of HK$1.01 per share, raising nearly HK$170 million before expenses, it said in a statement.
The company said 10 percent of the public offer had been allocated to employees.
Net proceeds of the offer would be used to finance outstanding equity contributions to seven existing joint venture companies and to achieve further integration of its timber operations, it said.
The company has 19 joint ventures in China, an associate company in Taiwan and a subsidiary in Brazil.

Ta Fu is a large timber products processor in China with extensive manufacturing facilities. Its product range includes wood panels such as veneer and fancy plywood as well as furniture, doors and flooring.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on December 27, it said.
